''See also: [[Zenith Cannon Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The [[Zenith]] Cannon is a sentient [[Zenith Device]], a category of highly advanced ancient human creations. While it possesses various names across different planets, its true identity is difficult to verify without other similar devices. In its current state, [[the Cannon]] takes the form of a standard [[plasma pistol]], though it also manifests visually as a small, multicolored sun with solar-flare-like arms. It possesses a distinct personality, capable of speaking, cackling, and even expressing emotions like indignation. The weapon is incredibly powerful; it has been described as having the destructive potential of an entire fleet or artillery platform contained within a single firearm. Its capabilities are significant enough that even studying its principles can allow others to develop immense firepower, and its acquisition by The Perfected{{!}}the Perfected is considered a major threat.}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The [[Zenith]] Cannon is one of the seven legendary [[Zenith Devices]] and a primary object of interest for the crew. Although it passed through Mell D-One-Twenty-Five{{!}}Mell's location a year prior, the weapon was eventually acquired by [[Benri Vallenar]] as part of a sacrificial play. While it appears to be a standard [[Lightcaster IV]] [[plasma pistol]] with a white metal shell, the device is actually a sentient weapon capable of speech and conducting quizzes. Its interior consists of folded space similar to the [[Shadow Ark]], providing enough room to contain a dreadnought without increasing its mass. After being acquired by The Perfected{{!}}the Perfected, the cannon was cradled by [[Omega]] and subjected to their whispering before Sola Kalter{{!}}Sola eventually moved it away.}}
